# People and cooperations

The project **WetFlorVegChange** was conceived by a team of Central European scientists, based primarily at Masaryk University ([Core team](https://wetflorvegchange.github.io/People/core_team.html)). However, because one of the main goals of this project is to build a European network of wetland‑vegetation ecologists and to assemble all existing vegetation‑plot time series of inland wetland habitats into the **ReSurveyWetlands database**, the project relies on the collaboration of numerous experts across Europe ([Data contributors](https://wetflorvegchange.github.io/People/data_contributors.html)).
